name: beeppy
description: Beeppy - un'ape, dei tronchi, una classifica mondiale

scripts.test: npm run check && node scripts/sim-check.js && node scripts/check-fairness.js
scripts.check: node -e "const{execSync}=require('child_process'),fs=require('fs'),os=require('os'),p=require('path');const t=fs.mkdtempSync(p.join(os.tmpdir(),'beeppy-'));let bad=0;for(const f of fs.readdirSync('js')){const m=p.join(t,f.replace(/\\.js$/,'.mjs'));fs.copyFileSync(p.join('js',f),m);try{execSync('node --check '+m,{stdio:'pipe'})}catch(e){console.error('ERRORE',f,String(e.stderr).split('\\n')[2]||'');bad++}}console.log(bad?bad+' file con errori':'sintassi dei moduli: ok');process.exit(bad?1:0)"
